title: How the Agentic Layer Works
subtitle: The technical backbone for smart workloads.

blueprint.title: Architecture Blueprint
blueprint.description: You're building smart agents? We provide the foundation. Our architecture is designed for maximum sovereignty, security, and seamless interoperability. The Agentic Layer acts as the central nervous system of your AI workforce: It's modular and provides the necessary abstractions to orchestrate, control, and securely integrate your agents into your existing IT landscape.

sovereignty.title: Sovereign Operations (BYOC & On-Premise)
sovereignty.description: The Agentic Layer enables complete operation of AI workloads in the customer's preferred cloud environment (Bring Your Own Cloud) or independently in their own data center. This ensures 100% control and maximum data sovereignty over the entire AI infrastructure.

governance.title: Central Governance & Agent Catalog
governance.description: A central governance layer prevents uncontrolled "agent sprawl". It ensures all agents can be consistently developed, approved, and operated according to defined standards. The integrated Agent Catalog serves to manage and organize the agent workforce.

router.title: Agnostic Model Router
router.description: The Model Router enables dynamic selection of the optimal AI model for each specific task. It intelligently routes requests to suitable models, from fast models for routine tasks to specialized models for complex analyses. This ensures maximum flexibility in model usage.

observability.title: Comprehensive Observability & Audit Logs
observability.description: The system provides deep insights into AI processes through comprehensive observability functions. Complete audit logs and end-to-end tracing enable full traceability and explainability of every single agent decision, creating transparency and trust.

runtime.title: Multi-Framework Agent Runtime
runtime.description: The Agent Runtime supports the operation of AI agents developed with various technologies and frameworks. This reduces onboarding time and enables teams to be immediately productive with familiar tools, significantly shortening development time.

testbench.title: Integrated Agent Testbench
testbench.description: An integrated testing environment enables systematic validation of agents before productive deployment. The testbench supports standardized tests for behavior, performance, and security of agents to ensure their quality and reliability.

standards.title: Open Standards for Future-Proofing
standards.description: The system is based on an open architecture and commits to industry standards like A2A (Agent-to-Agent Communication) and MCP (Multi-Agent Communication Protocol). This protects against vendor lock-in and ensures a future-proof, flexible, and extensible infrastructure.
